/-- The retained H48 gap for actual five tuple entries in the
no-small-entry branch.  The analytic forms, nonvanishing, integrality,
terminal norm bounds and normalized Vandermonde bounds are all derived;
no root witness or retained-gap inequality is assumed. -/
theorem full_ring_retained_three_h48_gap
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K]
    (hK : finrank ℚ K = 2) (phi : K →+* ℂ)
    {Tup : Finset (𝓞 K)} (hTup : IsD1 Tup)
    (a : Fin 5 → 𝓞 K) (hinj : Function.Injective a) (hmem : ∀ i, a i ∈ Tup)
    (hA : 3 ≤ ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖)
    (hAB : ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (a 1 : K)‖)
    (hBS : ‖phi (a 1 : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (a 2 : K)‖)
    (hfrontier : 2*‖phi (a 0 : K)‖*‖phi (a 1 : K)‖*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖ < ‖phi (a 3 : K)‖)
    (hproduct : 3*‖phi (a 0 : K)‖*‖phi (a 1 : K)‖*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖*‖phi (a 3 : K)‖ < ‖phi (a 4 : K)‖) :
    let v : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i => phi (a (![0,1,2] i) : K)
    let R := ‖coherentVandermonde3 v‖/(‖phi (a 1 : K)‖*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖^2)
    ((9999/10000 : ℝ)*(200/19)^2) *
      (1/R-(51051/400000 : ℝ)/(‖phi (a 0 : K)‖^2*‖phi (a 1 : K)‖^2))^2 *
        (‖phi (a 0 : K)‖^2*‖phi (a 3 : K)‖^5/‖phi (a 2 : K)‖^2) < ‖phi (a 4 : K)‖ := by
  let f : 𝓞 K →+* ℂ := phi.comp (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K)
  let v : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i => f (a (![0,1,2] i))
  let A := ‖f (a 0)‖
  let B := ‖f (a 1)‖
  let S := ‖f (a 2)‖
  let P := ‖f (a 3)‖
  let C := ‖f (a 4)‖
  let eta : ℂ := (f (a 3)*f (a 4))^(1/2 : ℂ)
  let Z := ‖coherentTerminalRoot (f (a 3)) (f (a 4)) eta‖
  let L := coherentQuotientForm v (coherentVandermonde3 v) (f (a 3)) (f (a 4)) eta
  let R := ‖coherentVandermonde3 v‖/(B*S^2)
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply NumberField.RingOfIntegers.ext
    exact phi.injective hxy
  have hv : Function.Injective v :=
    hf.comp (hinj.comp (by decide : Function.Injective (![0,1,2] : Fin 3 → Fin 5)))
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by change 0<‖phi (a 0 : K)‖; linarith only [hA]
  have hB3 : 3 ≤ B := hA.trans hAB
  have hS3 : 3 ≤ S := hB3.trans hBS
  have hB0 : 0 < B := by linarith
  have hS0 : 0 < S := by linarith
  have hparams := coherent_retained_h48_size_parameters A B S P C hA hAB hBS hfrontier hproduct
  have hP0 : 0 < P := by nlinarith only [hparams.1,hS3]
  have hC0 : 0 < C := by nlinarith only [hparams.2.2.2.1,hP0]
  have hSP : S ≤ P := by nlinarith only [hparams.1,hS0]
  have heta : eta^2 = f (a 3)*f (a 4) := coherent_cpow_half_sq _
  have hactual := full_ring_retained_three_h48_lower_upper hK phi hTup a hinj hmem
    hA hAB hBS hfrontier hproduct eta heta
  have hgap := full_ring_coherent_two_strong_gap_main hK phi hTup
    (hmem 1) (hmem 2) (hmem 3) (hmem 4)
    (hinj.ne (by decide)) (hinj.ne (by decide)) (hinj.ne (by decide))
    (hinj.ne (by decide)) (hinj.ne (by decide)) (hinj.ne (by decide))
    hBS hS3 hparams.1 hparams.2.1 (Or.inl hB3)
  have hratio := coherent_three_vandermonde_ratio_bounds v hv hA0 hAB hBS
  have hroots := coherent_terminal_root_norm_sq_bounds (f (a 3)) (f (a 4)) eta
    (norm_pos_iff.mp hP0) (norm_pos_iff.mp hC0) heta
    (by linarith only [hparams.2.2.2.2.1])
  have hZ : 0 < Z := by
    have hz0 : 0 ≤ Z := norm_nonneg _
    have hpos : 0 < (3999/4000 : ℝ)*P*C := by positivity
    nlinarith only [hz0,hpos,hroots.1]
  have hdelta : R*B*S^2 = ‖coherentVandermonde3 v‖ := by
    dsimp [R]
    field_simp
  have hupper : ‖L‖ < 51*(R*B*S^2)/(100*Z) +
      (19/200 : ℝ)*(R*B*S^2)*Z/(A*B*S*P^3) := by
    rw [hdelta]
    exact hactual.2.2
  exact retained_three_h48_scalar_gap A B S P C Z R ‖L‖
    hA hB3 hS3 hSP hZ hratio.1 hratio.2 hfrontier hgap
    hroots.1 hroots.2 hactual.2.1 hupper

/-- With the sharpened four-entry frontier, the retained actual tuple
gap gives the coefficient 400 used in the no-small-entry overlap table. -/
theorem full_ring_all_large_retained_monomial
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K]
    (hK : finrank ℚ K = 2) (phi : K →+* ℂ)
    {Tup : Finset (𝓞 K)} (hTup : IsD1 Tup)
    (a : Fin 5 → 𝓞 K) (hinj : Function.Injective a) (hmem : ∀ i, a i ∈ Tup)
    (hA : 3 ≤ ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖)
    (hAB : ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (a 1 : K)‖)
    (hBS : ‖phi (a 1 : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (a 2 : K)‖)
    (hfrontier : 3*‖phi (a 0 : K)‖*‖phi (a 1 : K)‖*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖ < ‖phi (a 3 : K)‖)
    (hproduct : 3*‖phi (a 0 : K)‖*‖phi (a 1 : K)‖*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖*‖phi (a 3 : K)‖ < ‖phi (a 4 : K)‖) :
    400*(‖phi (a 0 : K)‖^7*‖phi (a 1 : K)‖^5*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖^3) < ‖phi (a 4 : K)‖ := by
  let f : 𝓞 K →+* ℂ := phi.comp (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K)
  let v : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i => f (a (![0,1,2] i))
  let A := ‖f (a 0)‖
  let B := ‖f (a 1)‖
  let S := ‖f (a 2)‖
  let P := ‖f (a 3)‖
  let C := ‖f (a 4)‖
  let R := ‖coherentVandermonde3 v‖/(B*S^2)
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by change 0<‖phi (a 0 : K)‖; linarith only [hA]
  have hB3 : 3 ≤ B := hA.trans hAB
  have hB0 : 0 < B := by linarith
  have hS0 : 0 < S := hB0.trans_le hBS
  have hprod0 : 0 < A*B*S := by positivity
  change 3*A*B*S < P at hfrontier
  have hfront2 : 2*A*B*S < P := by nlinarith only [hfrontier,hprod0]
  have hret := full_ring_retained_three_h48_gap hK phi hTup a hinj hmem
    hA hAB hBS hfront2 hproduct
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply NumberField.RingOfIntegers.ext
    exact phi.injective hxy
  have hv : Function.Injective v :=
    hf.comp (hinj.comp (by decide : Function.Injective (![0,1,2] : Fin 3 → Fin 5)))
  have hratio := coherent_three_vandermonde_ratio_bounds v hv hA0 hAB hBS
  have hp5 : (3*A*B*S)^5 ≤ P^5 := by gcongr
  have hbase : 3^5*(A^7*B^5*S^3) ≤ A^2*P^5/S^2 := by
    calc
      _ = A^2*(3*A*B*S)^5/S^2 := by field_simp
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp5 (sq_nonneg A)) (sq_nonneg S)
  have hmon : 3^5*((9999/10000 : ℝ)*(200/19)^2)*
      (1/R-(51051/400000 : ℝ)/(A^2*B^2))^2*(A^7*B^5*S^3) < C := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbase
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ ((9999/10000 : ℝ)*(200/19)^2)*
        (1/R-(51051/400000 : ℝ)/(A^2*B^2))^2)
    have hc : ((9999/10000 : ℝ)*(200/19)^2)*
        (1/R-(51051/400000 : ℝ)/(A^2*B^2))^2*(A^2*P^5/S^2) < C := hret
    nlinarith only [h,hc]
  exact all_large_retained_gap_monomial A B S C R hA hB3 hS0 hratio.1 hratio.2 hmon

end D1Bound5

BennettTwoDenominatorClearing.lean:
import D1Bound5.BennettClearedResidues

namespace D1Bound5

variable {F : Type*} [Field F] [CharZero F]

/-- Exact monomial cancellation when the exponent left after clearing is
known to be nonnegative. -/
theorem bennett_cancel_power_denominator (x : F) (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (u v t : ℕ) (h : u = v + t) : x ^ u * (x⁻¹) ^ v = x ^ t := by
  rw [h, pow_add]
  calc
    _ = (x ^ v * (x⁻¹) ^ v) * x ^ t := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx, one_pow, one_mul]

/-- Column zero of the two-anchor construction: clearing the pole denominators
leaves an ordinary polynomial monomial. The omitted signs and generalized
choose factors are scalar factors, handled independently. -/
theorem bennett_two_clear_column_zero
    (a b c : F) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (k d0 d1 d2 h0 h1 h2 : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hd : d0 + d1 + d2 = 1) (hh : h0 + h1 + h2 + 1 = k + d0) :
    (a * b * (a - b) ^ 2) ^ k * (a * b * c) ^ (k - h0) *
        (b⁻¹) ^ (k + d1 + h1) * (a⁻¹) ^ (k + d2 + h2) =
      a ^ (d1 + h1) * b ^ (d2 + h2) * c ^ (k - h0) *
        (a - b) ^ (2 * k) := by
  have hA : a ^ k * a ^ (k - h0) * (a⁻¹) ^ (k + d2 + h2) =
      a ^ (d1 + h1) := by
    rw [← pow_add]
    apply bennett_cancel_power_denominator a ha
    omega
  have hB : b ^ k * b ^ (k - h0) * (b⁻¹) ^ (k + d1 + h1) =
      b ^ (d2 + h2) := by
    rw [← pow_add]
    apply bennett_cancel_power_denominator b hb
    omega
  calc
    _ = (a ^ k * a ^ (k - h0) * (a⁻¹) ^ (k + d2 + h2)) *
        (b ^ k * b ^ (k - h0) * (b⁻¹) ^ (k + d1 + h1)) *
          c ^ (k - h0) * (a - b) ^ (2 * k) := by
      simp only [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hA, hB]

/-- Column one of the two-anchor construction. The exact remaining factor
`a^k` is the column divisibility used by the arithmetic row-form argument. -/
theorem bennett_two_clear_column_one
    (a b c : F) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (k d0 d1 d2 h0 h1 h2 : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hd : d0 + d1 + d2 = 1) (hh : h0 + h1 + h2 + 1 = k + d1) :
    (a * b * (a - b) ^ 2) ^ k * (a * b * c + b) ^ (k - h1) *
        (b⁻¹) ^ (k + d0 + h0) * ((a - b)⁻¹) ^ (k + d2 + h2) =
      a ^ k * (a * c + 1) ^ (k - h1) * b ^ (d2 + h2) *
        (a - b) ^ (k - (d2 + h2)) := by
  have hbase : a * b * c + b = b * (a * c + 1) := by ring
  have hB : b ^ k * b ^ (k - h1) * (b⁻¹) ^ (k + d0 + h0) =
      b ^ (d2 + h2) := by
    rw [← pow_add]
    apply bennett_cancel_power_denominator b hb
    omega
  have hD : (a - b) ^ (2 * k) * ((a - b)⁻¹) ^ (k + d2 + h2) =
      (a - b) ^ (k - (d2 + h2)) := by
    apply bennett_cancel_power_denominator (a - b) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hab)
    omega
  rw [hbase]
  calc
    _ = a ^ k * (a * c + 1) ^ (k - h1) *
        (b ^ k * b ^ (k - h1) * (b⁻¹) ^ (k + d0 + h0)) *
          ((a - b) ^ (2 * k) * ((a - b)⁻¹) ^ (k + d2 + h2)) := by
      simp only [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hB, hD]

/-- Column two of the two-anchor construction, with its exact `b^k`
divisibility and every surviving nonnegative difference exponent. -/
theorem bennett_two_clear_column_two
    (a b c : F) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (k d0 d1 d2 h0 h1 h2 : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hd : d0 + d1 + d2 = 1) (hh : h0 + h1 + h2 + 1 = k + d2) :
    (a * b * (a - b) ^ 2) ^ k * (a * b * c + a) ^ (k - h2) *
        (a⁻¹) ^ (k + d0 + h0) * ((a - b)⁻¹) ^ (k + d1 + h1) =
      b ^ k * (b * c + 1) ^ (k - h2) * a ^ (d1 + h1) *
        (a - b) ^ (k - (d1 + h1)) := by
  have hbase : a * b * c + a = a * (b * c + 1) := by ring
  have hA : a ^ k * a ^ (k - h2) * (a⁻¹) ^ (k + d0 + h0) =
      a ^ (d1 + h1) := by
    rw [← pow_add]
    apply bennett_cancel_power_denominator a ha
    omega
  have hD : (a - b) ^ (2 * k) * ((a - b)⁻¹) ^ (k + d1 + h1) =
      (a - b) ^ (k - (d1 + h1)) := by
    apply bennett_cancel_power_denominator (a - b) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hab)
    omega
  rw [hbase]
  calc
    _ = b ^ k * (b * c + 1) ^ (k - h2) *
        (a ^ k * a ^ (k - h2) * (a⁻¹) ^ (k + d0 + h0)) *
          ((a - b) ^ (2 * k) * ((a - b)⁻¹) ^ (k + d1 + h1)) := by
      simp only [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hA, hD]

/-- Restoring the signs of the actual poles at zero. -/
theorem bennett_two_clear_column_zero_signed
    (a b c : F) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (k d0 d1 d2 h0 h1 h2 : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hd : d0 + d1 + d2 = 1) (hh : h0 + h1 + h2 + 1 = k + d0) :
    (a * b * (a - b) ^ 2) ^ k * (a * b * c) ^ (k - h0) *
        ((-b)⁻¹) ^ (k + d1 + h1) * ((-a)⁻¹) ^ (k + d2 + h2) =
      (-1 : F) ^ ((k + d1 + h1) + (k + d2 + h2)) *
        (a ^ (d1 + h1) * b ^ (d2 + h2) * c ^ (k - h0) *
          (a - b) ^ (2 * k)) := by
  calc
    _ = (-1 : F) ^ ((k + d1 + h1) + (k + d2 + h2)) *
        ((a * b * (a - b) ^ 2) ^ k * (a * b * c) ^ (k - h0) *
          (b⁻¹) ^ (k + d1 + h1) * (a⁻¹) ^ (k + d2 + h2)) := by
      simp only [inv_neg]
      rw [show -(b⁻¹) = (-1 : F)*b⁻¹ by ring,
        show -(a⁻¹) = (-1 : F)*a⁻¹ by ring]
      simp only [mul_pow, pow_add]
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [bennett_two_clear_column_zero a b c ha hb k d0 d1 d2 h0 h1 h2 hk hd hh]

/-- Restoring the sign of the actual pole `b-a` in column one. -/
theorem bennett_two_clear_column_one_signed
    (a b c : F) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (k d0 d1 d2 h0 h1 h2 : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hd : d0 + d1 + d2 = 1) (hh : h0 + h1 + h2 + 1 = k + d1) :
    (a * b * (a - b) ^ 2) ^ k * (a * b * c + b) ^ (k - h1) *
        (b⁻¹) ^ (k + d0 + h0) * ((b - a)⁻¹) ^ (k + d2 + h2) =
      (-1 : F) ^ (k + d2 + h2) *
        (a ^ k * (a * c + 1) ^ (k - h1) * b ^ (d2 + h2) *
          (a - b) ^ (k - (d2 + h2))) := by
  have hneg : b - a = -(a - b) := by ring
  calc
    _ = (-1 : F) ^ (k + d2 + h2) *
        ((a * b * (a - b) ^ 2) ^ k * (a * b * c + b) ^ (k - h1) *
          (b⁻¹) ^ (k + d0 + h0) * ((a - b)⁻¹) ^ (k + d2 + h2)) := by
      rw [hneg]
      simp only [inv_neg]
      rw [show -((a-b)⁻¹) = (-1 : F)*(a-b)⁻¹ by ring]
      simp only [mul_pow]
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [bennett_two_clear_column_one a b c hb hab k d0 d1 d2 h0 h1 h2 hk hd hh]

end D1Bound5

import D1Bound5.BennettClearedResidues
import D1Bound5.BennettBinomialTransfer
import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Ring.InfiniteSum
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity

open Finset

namespace D1Bound5

private theorem bennett_real_factorial_mul_choose (s : ℝ) (h : ℕ) :
    (h.factorial : ℝ) * Ring.choose s h = (descPochhammer ℝ h).eval s := by
  have heq : (descPochhammer ℤ h).smeval s =
      (descPochhammer ℝ h).eval s := by
    rw [Polynomial.descPochhammer_smeval_eq_ascPochhammer,
      Polynomial.ascPochhammer_smeval_eq_eval,
      descPochhammer_eval_eq_ascPochhammer]
  have hh := Ring.descPochhammer_eq_factorial_smul_choose s h
  rw [heq, nsmul_eq_mul] at hh
  exact hh.symm

/-- All coefficients used by the local Taylor residue lie before the first
sign change. An ordinary degree-(k+1) binomial dominates them coefficientwise.
The small extra factor will be absorbed by the manuscript's rounding to H2. -/
theorem bennett_shifted_half_choose_abs_le (k h : ℕ) (hh : h ≤ k) :
    |Ring.choose ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) h| ≤ (Nat.choose (k + 1) h : ℝ) := by
  have hh' : (h : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hh
  have hlow : (h : ℝ) - 1 ≤ (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hhigh : (h : ℝ) - 1 ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith
  have hupper : (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith
  have hf : 0 < (h.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hnonneg := descPochhammer_nonneg hlow
  rw [← bennett_real_factorial_mul_choose] at hnonneg
  have hc : 0 ≤ Ring.choose ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) h := by nlinarith
  have hmono := (monotoneOn_descPochhammer_eval h) hlow hhigh hupper
  rw [← bennett_real_factorial_mul_choose, ← bennett_real_factorial_mul_choose,
    Ring.choose_natCast] at hmono
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hc]
  exact (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left hf).mp hmono

/-- Norm coefficient majorants multiply by the actual Cauchy product. -/
theorem bennett_coeff_mul_norm_le
    (B C : PowerSeries ℂ) (D E : PowerSeries ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ h, ‖PowerSeries.coeff h B‖ ≤ PowerSeries.coeff h D)
    (hC : ∀ h, ‖PowerSeries.coeff h C‖ ≤ PowerSeries.coeff h E) (t : ℕ) :
    ‖PowerSeries.coeff t (B * C)‖ ≤ PowerSeries.coeff t (D * E) := by
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ hu ∈ antidiagonal t,
      ‖PowerSeries.coeff hu.1 B * PowerSeries.coeff hu.2 C‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro hu hhu
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hB hu.1) (hC hu.2) (norm_nonneg _)
        ((norm_nonneg _).trans (hB hu.1))

/-- Positive numerator majorant for every local coefficient of order at most k. -/
noncomputable def bennettNumeratorMajorant (U : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : PowerSeries ℝ :=
  PowerSeries.C U⁻¹ * (PowerSeries.C U + PowerSeries.X) ^ (k + 1)

theorem bennettNumeratorMajorant_coeff (U : ℝ) (hU : U ≠ 0)
    (k h : ℕ) (hh : h ≤ k) :
    PowerSeries.coeff h (bennettNumeratorMajorant U k) =
      (Nat.choose (k + 1) h : ℝ) * U ^ (k - h) := by
  rw [bennettNumeratorMajorant, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
    bennettSeries_coeff_C_add_X_pow]
  have hexp : k + 1 - h = k - h + 1 := by omega
  rw [hexp, pow_succ]
  field_simp [hU]
  <;> ring

theorem bennettNumeratorMajorant_coeff_nonneg (U : ℝ) (hU : 0 < U) (k h : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ PowerSeries.coeff h (bennettNumeratorMajorant U k) := by
  rw [bennettNumeratorMajorant, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
    bennettSeries_coeff_C_add_X_pow]
  positivity

/-- The finite numerator majorant has its ordinary polynomial value as sum. -/
theorem bennettNumeratorMajorant_hasSum (U r : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    HasSum (fun h : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff h (bennettNumeratorMajorant U k) * r ^ h)
      ((U + r) ^ (k + 1) / U) := by
  let P : Polynomial ℝ := Polynomial.C U⁻¹ * (Polynomial.C U + Polynomial.X) ^ (k + 1)
  have hP : (P : PowerSeries ℝ) = bennettNumeratorMajorant U k := by
    simp [P, bennettNumeratorMajorant]
  have hpzero (h : ℕ) (hh : h ∉ P.support) : P.coeff h * r ^ h = 0 := by
    have hcoeff : P.coeff h = 0 := by
      simpa only [Polynomial.mem_support_iff, not_not] using hh
    rw [hcoeff, zero_mul]

arises in Bennett's simultaneous approximants.  In contrast to a coefficient
envelope interface, every coefficient of the series below is specified.

polynomials is a separate theorem.  This file does not assume that an arbitrary
series is a Bennett residual.  Once that identification is available, the
specialization n = 3k, s = k + 1/2 gives exactly the eta exponent in the paper.

theorem bennett_multichoose_pos (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (t : ℕ) :
    0 < Ring.multichoose q t := by
  have h := Ring.factorial_nsmul_multichoose_eq_ascPochhammer q t
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul, Polynomial.ascPochhammer_smeval_eq_eval] at h

/-- The sign of a negative-upper binomial coefficient disappears into a
positive multichoose coefficient. -/
theorem bennett_choose_negative_abs (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (t : ℕ) :
    |Ring.choose (-q) t| = Ring.choose (q + t - 1) t := by
  rw [Ring.choose_neg', Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul,
    Int.cast_negOnePow_natCast, abs_mul, abs_pow]
  simp only [abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, one_mul]

coefficient counting factor. -/
theorem bennett_choose_tail_identity (s : ℝ) (n t : ℕ) :

      |Ring.choose s n| * |Ring.choose (s - n) t| := by
  have h := Ring.choose_smul_choose s (n := n + t) (k := n)
    (Nat.le_add_right n t)

  have ha := congrArg abs h
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)] at ha
  rw [Nat.choose_symm_add] at ha
  simpa only [mul_comm] using ha

/-- Exact real sum of the absolute negative-binomial series, using the analytic
binomial theorem already proved in mathlib. -/
theorem bennett_negative_binomial_abs_hasSum (q r : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) :
    HasSum (fun t : ℕ => |Ring.choose (-q) t| * r ^ t)

theorem bennett_homogeneous_tail_summable_and_norm_le

    (a : ι → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (s ρ : ℝ) (x : ℂ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card ι = n + 1)
    (hs : s < n) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (ha : ∀ i, ‖a i‖ ≤ ρ) (hradius : ρ * ‖x‖ < 1) :
    Summable (fun t : ℕ =>
      (Ring.choose s (n + t) : ℂ) *
        MvPolynomial.aeval a (MvPolynomial.hsymm ι ℂ t) * x ^ (n + t)) ∧
    ‖∑' t : ℕ, (Ring.choose s (n + t) : ℂ) *
        MvPolynomial.aeval a (MvPolynomial.hsymm ι ℂ t) * x ^ (n + t)‖ ≤

  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := mul_nonneg hρ0 (norm_nonneg _)
  have hsum := bennett_negative_binomial_abs_hasSum q r hq hr0 hradius
  have hscaled : Summable (fun t : ℕ =>
      (|Ring.choose s n| * ‖x‖ ^ n) *
        (|Ring.choose (-q) t| * r ^ t)) :=
    hsum.summable.mul_left (|Ring.choose s n| * ‖x‖ ^ n)
  have hterm (t : ℕ) :

    have hid := bennett_choose_tail_identity s n t
    have hsq : s - n = -q := by dsimp [q]; ring
    rw [hsq] at hid
    calc
      ‖(Ring.choose s (n + t) : ℂ) *
          MvPolynomial.aeval a (MvPolynomial.hsymm ι ℂ t) * x ^ (n + t)‖ =
        |Ring.choose s (n + t)| *
          ‖MvPolynomial.aeval a (MvPolynomial.hsymm ι ℂ t)‖ * ‖x‖ ^ (n + t) := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_choose,
              Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ |Ring.choose s (n + t)| *
          ((Nat.choose (n + t) t : ℝ) * ρ ^ t) * ‖x‖ ^ (n + t) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
            simpa only [hidx] using hsymm_aeval_complex_norm_le_choose a t ρ hρ0 ha

          (‖x‖ ^ n * r ^ t) := by
            simp only [r, pow_add, mul_pow]
            ring

          (|Ring.choose (-q) t| * r ^ t) := by rw [hid]; ring
  have hcomplex : Summable (fun t : ℕ =>
      (Ring.choose s (n + t) : ℂ) *
        MvPolynomial.aeval a (MvPolynomial.hsymm ι ℂ t) * x ^ (n + t)) :=
    Summable.of_norm_bounded hscaled hterm
  have hnorm : Summable (fun t : ℕ =>
      ‖(Ring.choose s (n + t) : ℂ) *
        MvPolynomial.aeval a (MvPolynomial.hsymm ι ℂ t) * x ^ (n + t)‖) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hterm hscaled
  refine ⟨hcomplex, ?_⟩
  calc
    ‖∑' t : ℕ, (Ring.choose s (n + t) : ℂ) *
        MvPolynomial.aeval a (MvPolynomial.hsymm ι ℂ t) * x ^ (n + t)‖ ≤
      ∑' t : ℕ, ‖(Ring.choose s (n + t) : ℂ) *
        MvPolynomial.aeval a (MvPolynomial.hsymm ι ℂ t) * x ^ (n + t)‖ :=
          norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm
    _ ≤ ∑' t : ℕ, (|Ring.choose s n| * ‖x‖ ^ n) *
        (|Ring.choose (-q) t| * r ^ t) :=
          hnorm.tsum_le_tsum hterm hscaled
    _ = |Ring.choose s n| * ‖x‖ ^ n / (1 - ρ * ‖x‖) ^ ((n : ℝ) - s) := by
      rw [tsum_mul_left, hsum.tsum_eq]
      simp only [q, r, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul]

/-- The two-anchor Bennett exponent is exactly 2k-1/2. -/
theorem bennett_two_homogeneous_tail_summable_and_norm_le
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (a : ι → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (x : ℂ)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hcard : Fintype.card ι = 3 * k + 1)
    (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (ha : ∀ i, ‖a i‖ ≤ ρ)

      (Ring.choose ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) (3 * k + t) : ℂ) *
        MvPolynomial.aeval a (MvPolynomial.hsymm ι ℂ t) * x ^ (3 * k + t)) ∧
    ‖∑' t : ℕ, (Ring.choose ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) (3 * k + t) : ℂ) *
        MvPolynomial.aeval a (MvPolynomial.hsymm ι ℂ t) * x ^ (3 * k + t)‖ ≤
      |Ring.choose ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) (3 * k)| * ‖x‖ ^ (3 * k) /
        (1 - ρ * ‖x‖) ^ (2 * (k : ℝ) - 1 / 2) := by
  have hk' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hs : (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2 < (3 * k : ℕ) := by
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hexp : ((3 * k : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) =

  simpa [hexp] using
    bennett_homogeneous_tail_summable_and_norm_le a (3 * k)

@[simp] theorem bennettPoleMajorant_coeff (d : ℝ) (p n : ℕ) :

  | zero =>
      convert (hasSum_ite_eq (0 : ℕ) (1 : ℝ)) using 1
      · ext n
        by_cases hn : n = 0
        · subst n
          simp
        · simp [bennettPoleMajorant_coeff, Ring.choose_zero_ite, hn]
      · simp

      have hratio0 : 0 ≤ r/d := div_nonneg hr0 hd.le

    (hQ : ∀ n, 0 ≤ PowerSeries.coeff n Q)
    (hs : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff n P * r^n) s)
    (ht : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff n Q * r^n) t) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff n (P*Q) * r^n) (s*t) := by

    (fun n => mul_nonneg (hQ n) (pow_nonneg hr n))

  have hcoeff :
      (fun n : ℕ => ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,

      (fun n : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff n (P*Q)*r^n) := by
    funext n
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro ij hij
    have hsumij := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij
    rw [← hsumij, pow_add]
    ring
  rw [hcoeff] at hsum heq

theorem bennett_positive_series_coeff_le_sum
    (P : PowerSeries ℝ) (r s : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hP : ∀ n, 0 ≤ PowerSeries.coeff n P)
    (hs : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff n P * r^n) s) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n P * r^n ≤ s := by
  rw [← hs.tsum_eq]
  exact hs.summable.le_tsum n
    (fun m _ => mul_nonneg (hP m) (pow_nonneg hr m))

/-- A useful ready-to-apply two-pole coefficient bound. -/
theorem bennett_two_pole_majorant_coeff_le
    (d e r : ℝ) (p q n : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (he : 0 < e)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrd : r < d) (hre : r < e) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (bennettPoleMajorant d p * bennettPoleMajorant e q) * r^n ≤
